ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $3.33 voucher to the rider for the unexempted detour distance; record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file (no account flag — driver has 0 upheld route disputes in 90 d).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 18:53–19:01 with +2.11 km and a detour of up to 995 m from the optimal route (F3). Driver's breakdown claim (F8) is partly corroborated by F11 (breakdown 18:27, 0 m from optimal route, before segment start, within trip window) which satisfies RD-4(a)'s timing/location tests, but the deviation removed the trip from the affected optimal route while the alternative corridor (F9 ECP band 4, F10 Airport Boulevard band 4) was itself slow, so the reasonable-cause exemption does not cover this deviation; F9/F10 are band facts only and cannot exempt alone (RD-4(b)/G3). No chat agreement to the route change exists (F7), so RD-5 gives no exemption. Segment remains unexempted under RD-1 → RD-2 refund.

rejected_claims.reason: F11 corroborates a breakdown on the optimal route, but the deviation went up to 995 m off that route onto an equally slow corridor (F9/F10); the RD-4(a) reasonable-cause exception does not extend to this segment.
RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's extra km; the residual difference between fare-excess (2.4 km) and the segment sum (~0.29 km) is map-matching residual and is not refunded.
